name: 01104 · Springfield, MA
findings: ZIP 01104 (Springfield) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01104 (Springfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01104 (Springfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 11 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01104 (Springfield) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.
